transcript.text: Namaste! Main Priya bol rahi hoon Aarambh Realty se — do minute baat kar sakte hain?

Haan namaste Priya ji. Actually main Gurgaon mein, specifically Golf Course Road par ek 3BHK dekh raha hoon, budget mera 2 crore tak ka hai. Kya is budget mein aapke paas Gurgaon mein kuch bhi chalega, ya fir Dwarka side kuch options hain aapke paas?

Achha, Gurgaon mein Golf Course Road par dekh rahe hain. Sir, main aapko batana chahungi ki hum Aarambh Realty sirf Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad aur Yamuna Expressway par focus karte hain. Gurgaon mein humari properties nahi hain. Kya aap Noida ya Greater Noida Expressway mein 3BHK ke options dekhna chahenge? Do crore tak ke budget mein.
Oh, Noida side toh hum abhi nahi dekh rahe hain. Gurgaon mein aapke paas bilkul bhi koi option nahi hai kya, ya fir Dwarka Expressway side kuch mil sakta hai is budget mein?

Nahi sir, sorry Gurgaon ya Dwarka Expressway side humare paas koi options nahi hain. Aarambh Realty sirf inhi areas mein kaam karti hai. Agar aapka mind change ho, Noida ya Greater Noida ke liye, toh please bataiyega, main aapko kuch bahut hi achhe projects suggest kar sakti hoon. Ready to move options bhi hain, possession wale bhi.
Achha chalo koi baat nahi, abhi toh Noida side ka koi plan nahi hai humara. Agar aage kabhi mind change hua toh main aapko zaroor contact karunga, thank you!
Koi baat nahi, sir. Thank you so much for calling! Have a great day.
